text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"It came from over here...! 
...Ah! Isn't that the street live 
performance...!?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Pshuuuuu...! My eeeears~~~~...! 
I jumped so hard in surprise I hit my 
forehead~~~!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Fortissimo...! Was the monitor return too 
strong? 
Audio feedback is far too harsh on an 
Umamusume's ears."
(SCREEEEEEECH—!!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAHHH—!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Oh no no no... I-It's complete chaos...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"(After practicing so hard, too... 
At this rate, forget entertaining the 
fans—)"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Guy
text_block_list.text:
"Oh boy~ the amplifier's in a bad spot. 
The sound's clashing. 
Turbo-chan, try shifting the angle a bit!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, you're totally fine! 
We'll wait as long as it takes, keep at 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Auuuugh~~~~ We are so sorry, it's a total 
mess...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Turbo-san, are you all right? 
Jeez, you just kept getting louder and 
louder to fight the feedback."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo... Turbo can still sing~~~ *cough*, 
*hack*...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Such fleeting, yet powerfully unrefined 
vibrato... 
To make my soul resonate so deeply, what 
is it that you seek?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't hit on her at a time like this!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Guy
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, take a deep breath! You can't 
sing when you're out of oxygen. 
Everyone together now, on three! 
Inhaaaale, exhaaaale...!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Nnnnghh~~~~! Turbo is rebooouuund! 
Everyboooody—! Are you still ready to 
goooo—!?"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOO—!!!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"That was just the prologue! What they 
call warming up the venue! 
Now, let's soar straight to being the 
stars of the party!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Ba-dump ba-dump ba-dump! Ba-dump ba-dump 
ba-duuump~!?"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"—My favorite Umamusume!! 
—My favorite Umamusume!!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(H-Huh...? If anything, they're getting 
super hyped...?)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Guy
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Now THAT'S the Nat-chan and crew 
we know and love!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Royce-chan, Turbo-chan, and 
Earth-chan too! 
—No matter what happens, they never give 
up halfway!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I've never spent—a New Year's Eve—like 
this befoooore!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Even if we're not perfect, our fans tell 
us that's okay. 
For some reason, they cheer us on anyway."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I said it's going well, but I'm just 
leaving everything to Big Sis and Vivlos. 
If they weren't there, I wouldn't even 
know how to please the fans..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Still, something feels off.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Our original plan was to win popularity 
by standing out, 
but our amateurish desperation really 
captured the fans' hearts!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Now, our next move is to walk around the 
festival 
and soak up all the 'You were great 
earlier!' cheers...!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "...Oh? What about you two...?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I see. You're supposed to have satisfied 
your fans, yet it doesn't feel right to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I thought I gave fan service on par 
with popular Umamusume like Kitasan and 
Satono. But..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I feel like something at the core is 
fundamentally different from what my 
father and grandfather used to do for 
their fans..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, there's something bothering me 
too... 
I did my best even with things I'm not 
used to, just like my sisters told me, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Even though we messed up during the live 
show just now... 
everyone looked like they were having so 
much fun..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Aha, I see it now. Where you two went 
wrong.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Do either of you know why your fans are 
your fans in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Why they are... my fans...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume are all unique. The reasons 
people support us vary. 
Exactly! In other words, fans are drawn to 
our 'individuality'!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"This festival was really just meant to be 
a relaxed hangout with everyone, so we 
didn't actually need to push ourselves so 
hard for the band."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Yet because we decided to do it, we 
put in the effort. 
Even when we made mistakes, we kept 
singing to see it through to the end."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: And we're the exact same way during races.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Even if the results aren't great, we 
don't give up and keep our eyes on the 
next race! 
We pick ourselves back up, determined to 
seize victory next time!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Without even realizing it, we showed our 
fans the side of us they love most—our 
true, authentic selves...!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Our true... selves.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Each of us has our own individuality, 
and each of us is loved in our own way."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"If you don't know what it is about you 
that they love... 
you'll never be able to truly answer your 
fans' feelings!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. I'm not Kitasan, nor am I 
anyone else. 
I am me... and my fans are MY fans."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I've been leaving everything to Big 
Sis and Vivlos, 
but I haven't done anything for my fans in 
a true sense..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"That said, there's no time to prepare 
roundabout fan service now. 
In that case, let's take a direct 
approach."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Let's show our fans who love each of us 
our true selves, just as we are!"
